description:
Render reference images, which keep each character, environment and
object looking the same in every segment. Needs both style template
images. Without asset_ids it renders every asset with none, skipping
ones already rendering, so a repeat never bills twice. Afterwards,
view_image them to check likeness.

asset_ids.description: Assets to render, again if they have one; omit for every asset without a reference image

dry_run.description: Return the count and credit estimate; start nothing

editable_sections.description: Template prompt section overrides, keyed by section id

model.description: Model id (get_generation_options); omit for the saved choice

settings.description: Model settings: keys of its settings_schema

name: assets_generate
title: Generate reference images
